payload.rationale: This sprint retro touches three overlapping regions: (1) the Sprint 4 retro document itself and its direct observations/positions — Zephyr integration as the velocity unlock, 23-point velocity metric, thesis-proven claim, and the style observations about direct quotes and metric anchoring; (2) the core product narratives — AntiSlackPositioning, DecisionsEvaporate, and DecisionCaptureAtConsensus — because Tanya's retro claims the thesis is validated by shipping the widget, which directly extends these narratives; (3) the positioning and pricing positions (ProductCategoryAsyncPlatform, AntiPatternRealtimeChat, PricingTwelveDollars, PricingTier25Plus, TargetMarketRemoteTeams, WebhookArchitecture, ContextPreservationNextSprint) because the retro's velocity and Zephyr claims bear on the product category, pricing justification, architecture decisions, and next-sprint priorities. I did not expand the Thematic or Documents doors as they returned NOT FOUND — the graph is small enough that all relevant nodes were already surfaced through the focus section and the AntiSlackPositioning child index.
